episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the transformative impact of AI on the real estate industry, emphasizing the importance of relationship building and advisory roles for agents. The conversation also covers the future of Zillow's dominance and the strategic moves by Compass, highlighting the need for agents to leverage social media to build their personal brand and stay competitive.
